content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Two years' experience in Microbiology laboratory/ Tuberculosis Laboratory / relevant subject/field; Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in Microbiology laboratory/ Tuberculosis Laboratory / relevant subject/field Experience: Two years' experience in Microbiology laboratory/ Tuberculosis Laboratory / relevant subject/field Age limit: Maximum 28 years Other conditions: Distance educational qualification will not be considered. Selection will not be an employment on AIIMS Raipur pay-roll. Desirable: Experience in collection/ transport/ handling of clinical samples including sputum and saliva Hands-on experience with handling of GeneXpert/ CBNAAT/TruNat / any PCR/RT PCR instrument Hands-on experience in Sample processing for TB diagnosis by smear microscopy, culture in MGIT, GeneXpert and LPA Maintenance of stocks, basic biosafety practices, accurate pipetting, preparation of media, autoclaving, and routine equipment operation Maintenance of detailed lab notebooks, reagent logs, basic data entry and analysis

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Project Technical Support-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The job responsibilities assigned to the Project Technical Support-I include: Sample collection from suspected TB patients especialy Sputum and Saliva. Transport/Handling/ storage of samples. Clinical data collection and entry into CRF, software and maintenance in registers. Assistance in other laboratory related work in TB Laboratory. Completion of any work assigned by PI and Co-PI to ensure the smooth functioning of the project. Handling project-related documents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial contract appointment for 3 months only Extendable up to a maximum of 6 months as per project need upon PI's recommendation

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Raipur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application scrutiny by the selection committee Written screening test (conducted if eligible candidates are more than 30 per post) Interview of top 10 candidates scoring highest marks in the written test Recruitments will be made through Interview. A written screening test will be conducted if the number of eligible candidates is more than 30 per post. Top 10 candidates scoring highest marks in the written test will be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SSC or 10th class marks card/certificate for proof of date of birth Certificates to support academic qualifications starting from bachelor's degree Work experience certificates Research experience certificates Higher qualification certificates if any Two recent passport-sized photographs Aadhar Card NOC if presently working with any government organization

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raipur Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the AIIMS Raipur website. Fill the application form properly and sign it, pasting a recent self-signed passport-sized color photograph. Attach self-attested copies of certificates in a zip folder or single pdf named as Candidate's name and post's name. Email the application form and documents to [email protected] on or before 31.10.26 by 05:00PM. Subject of the email should be Application for the post of Project Technical support-I for TB - RAP study. Email it on or before 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Applications not sent in the attached format will be rejected. No separate personalized communication will be sent to the candidates.
